title: How a TAP signature base is built
caption: The covered components become one line each, the signature parameters become the last line, and the agent signs that exact text. The method, query string and body are not in the minimum set, so they are not protected.
alt: Flowchart. From the request, the Host value becomes the @authority line, the path becomes the @path line, and the Signature-Input parameters become the last line, @signature-params, which repeats the component list and the parameters created, keyid, alg, expires, nonce and tag. The agent signs the three lines with its key, Ed25519 in the examples, producing the Signature header value. The verifier rebuilds the same base and checks it with the public key. A note says the method, the query and the body are not covered by the minimum set.

sourceOfTruth.label: RFC 9421 section 2.5 (signature base) and the TAP specification
